title: [Main] Expense Agent: register the Copilot capability as generally available
summary: The Expense Agent Copilot capability is now registered as Generally Available instead of Preview, applying the same pattern used by the Sales Order and Payables agents.
key_points: Install process now registers the capability as Generally Available from the start
If already registered as Preview, the capability is modified to Generally Available status
Upgrade process automatically moves existing tenants from Preview to GA status
Deactivated capabilities are re-activated once during the upgrade to GA
Pattern matches the existing implementation for Sales Order and Payables agents
